intro: Whoever holds the communication role writes; another person from communication approves before it goes out. The post carries the organization's name, not the writer's, and the database forgets who wrote and who approved as soon as it is decided.
soNucleo: You moderate a chapter of this organization: here you can call your chapter. The post queue belongs to the communication role.

escrever.nota: It stays in the queue until another person from communication approves it. It expires after 14 days without a decision.

fila.outra: Another person from communication wrote this
fila.esperaOutra: Waiting for another person to approve.
fila.retido: Screening held the post for moderation.

nucleo.ajuda: A message from the organization just for the chapter, which notifies each person in it. At most 2 per week per chapter, counting everyone with a role.
nucleo.retido: Moderation is reviewing the message before the chapter is notified.
nucleo.confirma: Call all of {nome}? Each person in the chapter gets a notification.

boletim.ajuda: Pick the week's posts and write the opening. It goes through the queue like any text and carries the organization's name.
boletim.assinantes: {n} people asked for the newsletter, {e} also by e-mail.
boletim.poucas: Fewer than 3 people asked for the newsletter.
boletim.ultimo: The last one went out on {data}.
boletim.proximo: The next one can go out from {data}.
boletim.posts: Posts from the last 8 days (up to 12)
boletim.semPosts: The organization has not posted anything in the last 8 days.
boletim.email: People who asked by e-mail get the opening and only the beginning of public posts, without links, in an e-mail of their own.

dominio.ajuda: The organization's website shows on the profile once it proves it owns it.
dominio.semSelo: Only organizations with the seal can prove a domain.
dominio.como: Prove it in one of two ways and tap Check now:
dominio.naoAchou: We haven't found the code yet. A DNS change can take a few hours to show up.
dominio.tirarConfirma: Remove the domain from the profile? To bring it back, it must be proven again.

perfil.dominioTitulo: On {data} the organization proved it owns this domain.
perfil.boletimAjuda: The weekly summary the organization picks.
perfil.assino: You get the newsletter on Alumia.
perfil.assinoEmail: You get the newsletter on Alumia and by e-mail.
perfil.emailNota: The e-mail goes to your account's address, on its own: nobody sees who else receives it.

erros.falha: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
erros.semBanco: This part isn't switched on on this server yet.
erros.sem_permissao: Only someone with the communication role (or the right role) can do this.
erros.nao_encontrado: Not found. It may already have been decided.
erros.ja_decidido: Someone else already decided this text.
erros.outra_pessoa: The writer can't approve their own text: another person from communication approves it.
erros.dado_pessoal: Remove ID numbers, phone, e-mail or street address: that doesn't go public.
erros.fila_cheia: There are already 30 texts waiting. Decide some first.
erros.modelo_existe: There is already a template with that name.
erros.teto_do_nucleo: This chapter has already been called twice this week.
erros.boletim_cedo: A newsletter went out less than 6 days ago.
erros.boletim_esperando: A newsletter is already waiting for approval.
erros.sem_selo: Only organizations with the seal can prove a domain.
erros.dominio_em_uso: Another organization has already proven this domain.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests in a row. Wait a little.
erros.vencido: This text waited more than 14 days and expired. Write it again if it still applies.
